mapper.sql: id, phone, `name`, identification_number, apartment_id, room_id, lease_start_date, lease_end_date, lease_term_id, rent, deposit, payment_type_id, `status`, source_type, additional_info, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT la.id, la.lease_start_date, la.lease_end_date, la.rent, la.status lease_status, la.source_type, ai.name apartment_name, ri.room_number, gi.name, gi.url FROM lease_agreement la LEFT JOIN apartment_info ai ON la.apartment_id = ai.id AND ai.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_info ri ON la.room_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN graph_info gi ON la.room_id = gi.item_id AND gi.item_type = 2 AND gi.is_deleted = 0 WHERE la.is_deleted = 0 AND la.phone = #{phone,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT la.id, la.phone, la.name, la.identification_number, la.apartment_id, la.room_id, la.lease_start_date, la.lease_end_date, la.lease_term_id, la.rent, la.deposit, la.payment_type_id, la.status, la.source_type, la.additional_info, la.create_time, la.update_time, la.is_deleted, ai.name, ri.room_number, lt.month_count lease_term_month_count, lt.unit lease_term_unit, pt.name payment_type_name, agi.url apartment_graph_url, agi.name apartment_graph_name, rgi.url room_graph_url, rgi.name room_graph_name FROM lease_agreement la LEFT JOIN apartment_info ai ON la.apartment_id = ai.id AND ai.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN room_info ri ON la.room_id = ri.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lease_term lt ON la.lease_term_id = lt.id AND lt.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN payment_type pt ON la.payment_type_id = pt.id AND pt.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN graph_info agi ON la.apartment_id = agi.item_id AND agi.item_type = 1 AND agi.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN graph_info rgi ON la.room_id = rgi.item_id AND rgi.item_type = 2 AND rgi.is_deleted = 0 WHERE la.is_deleted = 0 AND la.id = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT}
